name: Google AI Studio
shortDescription: Free playground to test prompts on Google's Gemini models.
bestFor: Testing and improving prompts for free, with full control over the settings
about: Google AI Studio is a free web tool for trying prompts on Google's Gemini models. Unlike the normal Gemini app, it lets you set a system prompt, change the temperature, and compare results.
It is a great place to learn prompt writing, and developers use it to get an API key and turn a working prompt into code.
useCases: Write and test a system prompt for a chatbot
Compare how small prompt changes affect the answer
Test prompts on long documents, images, audio and video
Get code for a prompt to use in your own app
features: Upload files, images, audio and video
"Get code" to copy a working prompt into an app

howToUse.title: Sign in
howToUse.text: Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with your Google account.

howToUse.title: Write the system instructions
howToUse.text: Describe the role and rules, for example "You are a friendly tutor. Always answer in 3 short steps."

howToUse.title: Test with real inputs
howToUse.text: Send several example questions, including tricky ones, and read the answers.

howToUse.title: Change one thing at a time
howToUse.text: Edit one line of the prompt or the temperature, then test again so you know what helped.

howToUse.title: Save or export
howToUse.text: Save the prompt, or click Get code to use it in an app.

tips: A good prompt has: role, task, context, format and an example.
Lower temperature gives more consistent answers; higher gives more creative ones.
Keep a list of test questions and rerun them after every change.
examplePrompt: System: You are a customer support assistant for an online clothing shop. Be polite, answer in under 80 words, and if you don't know, say you will connect the customer to a person.
limitations: Free use has rate limits, and Google may use free-tier data to improve its products.
It is a testing tool, not a polished chat app.
freePlanDetails: Free in the browser with rate limits.
cheapestPaidPlan: Pay as you go for the Gemini API
pricingNote: You pay only if you use the API above the free limits.

name: OpenAI Playground
shortDescription: Test and tune prompts on OpenAI's models before using them in an app.
bestFor: Building and testing prompts for apps that use OpenAI's models
about: The OpenAI Playground is a testing area on OpenAI's developer platform. You can write system prompts, try different models, change settings and save prompts to reuse in code.
It is aimed at people building apps, bots and automations, but it is also a good way to learn how prompts and settings change the output.
useCases: Write a system prompt for a chatbot or assistant
Compare models on the same prompt
Test structured output, such as JSON
Save a prompt and call it from your app
features: Tools such as web search and file search for testing

howToUse.title: Create a platform account
howToUse.text: Sign in at platform.openai.com. This is separate from a ChatGPT subscription.

howToUse.title: Add API credit
howToUse.text: Add a payment method and some credit in Billing. Usage is charged per token.

howToUse.title: Open the Playground
howToUse.text: Write your system instructions and pick a model.

howToUse.title: Test and compare
howToUse.text: Send test messages, change one thing, and compare the results.

howToUse.title: Save the prompt
howToUse.text: Save it to reuse in code with its ID.

tips: Ask for output in a fixed format (for example JSON with named fields) when an app will read it.
Test with bad and unusual inputs, not just easy ones.
examplePrompt: System: Extract the name, phone number and city from the customer's message and reply only with JSON: {"name":"","phone":"","city":""}.
limitations: There is no free plan. You need API credit, and you pay with a card that works for international payments.
A ChatGPT Plus subscription does not include API credit.
freePlanDetails: No free plan. You add API credit first.
cheapestPaidPlan: Pay as you go — charged per use
pricingNote: Price depends on the model and how much text you send and receive.

name: Claude Console
shortDescription: Anthropic's developer console with a prompt generator and prompt improver.
bestFor: Turning a rough idea into a well-structured prompt with the prompt generator
about: The Claude Console is Anthropic's site for developers. Its Workbench lets you test prompts on Claude models, and it has two helpful tools: a prompt generator that writes a full prompt from a short description, and a prompt improver that rewrites a prompt you already have.
You can also run your prompt on many test cases at once to see where it fails.
useCases: Generate a detailed prompt from a one-line idea
Improve an existing prompt that gives weak answers
Test a prompt on many examples at once
Get code to use a prompt in your app

howToUse.title: Create an account
howToUse.text: Sign up at console.anthropic.com. It is separate from a Claude.ai subscription.

howToUse.title: Add credit
howToUse.text: Add a payment method and buy API credit in Billing.

howToUse.title: Generate a prompt
howToUse.text: Click Generate a prompt, describe your task in a sentence or two, and let it write the full prompt.

howToUse.title: Test it
howToUse.text: Run it in the Workbench with real examples.

howToUse.title: Improve it
howToUse.text: Use the prompt improver, or edit by hand, and test again.

tips: Use the generated prompt as a starting point, then edit it to fit your case.
Put changing parts in variables like {{customer_message}} so you can test many inputs.
examplePrompt: Task for the prompt generator: "Write product descriptions for a Pakistani clothing brand from a list of fabric, colour and size details, in a warm tone, under 60 words."
limitations: No free plan. You need API credit, paid with a card that works for international payments.
A Claude Pro subscription does not include API credit.
freePlanDetails: No free plan. You add API credit first.
cheapestPaidPlan: Pay as you go — charged per use
pricingNote: Price depends on the model and how much text you send and receive.
